papers.title: Personalized Feedback Strategies for Online Learning Cohorts
papers.abstract: Investigates feedback policies in online classrooms with moderate gains on completion rates.
papers.findings: Personalized nudges improved assignment completion by 8% compared to static reminders.
limitations: Dataset over-represents high-performing students and underrepresents struggling cohorts.
No longitudinal follow-up beyond one semester.
future_work: Study patient-specific or student-specific adaptation in longer deployments.
Evaluate fairness across socioeconomic and language groups.

papers.title: Benchmarking Explainable Clinical Triage Assistants
papers.abstract: Benchmarks triage assistants for emergency intake tasks under synthetic scenarios.
papers.findings: LLM-assisted triage reduced queue time but generated inconsistent rationales.
limitations: Interpretability scores vary widely between demographic subgroups.
Evaluation used synthetic data, limiting real-world validity.
future_work: Conduct in-the-wild deployment studies in real emergency departments.
Add fairness constraints in triage recommendation scoring.

papers.title: Multimodal Workload Estimation for Hybrid Teams
papers.abstract: Estimates team workload using chat, meeting transcripts, and calendar metadata.
papers.findings: Multimodal features outperform text-only baselines on short-term workload prediction.
limitations: Model drifts after 6 weeks due to process changes.
No causal explanation for feature importance shifts.
future_work: Investigate temporal adaptation mechanisms for long-term use.
Improve transparent reasoning for managerial adoption.

papers.title: Low-Resource NLP for Public Service Chatbots
papers.abstract: Builds multilingual intent detection for government service chatbots.
papers.findings: Active learning improves intent coverage in minority languages.
limitations: Small labeled corpora leads to brittle behavior for domain transfer.
future_work: Develop robust transfer methods with few-shot adaptation.
Systematically audit fairness across dialect communities.

papers.title: Deploying AI Mental Health Assistants in University Settings
papers.abstract: Reports pilot deployment of AI support assistants for student well-being.
papers.findings: Engagement improved in early weeks but dropped over time.
limitations: Limited follow-up prevents understanding long-term safety outcomes.
Intervention effects may differ across cultural contexts.
future_work: Perform longitudinal safety analysis over full academic year.

papers.title: Reproducibility Challenges in Applied LLM Product Teams
papers.abstract: Surveys reproducibility failures in production LLM deployments.
papers.findings: Evaluation drift and undocumented prompts are top failure points.
limitations: Limited sample size from a narrow set of organizations.
No standardized framework for impact vs feasibility tradeoffs.
future_work: Create benchmarked protocols for rapid but reliable experiment cycles.
Quantify deployment readiness indicators in real-world settings.
